anomalies.observed: R3, the series resistor feeding the channel-1 servo signal (J3 pin 3) from /PWM1, has value "1M" (SPICE: `R3 Net-_J3-Pin_3_ /PWM1 1Meg`), while its counterpart R4 on channel 2 is "1k". Both carry the same LCSC code (C21190), so they are meant to be the same part.
anomalies.expected: The specification states R3 and R4 are '1k each' series resistors from the PWM1/PWM2 GPIO nets to J3 pin 3 / J8 pin 3. R3 should be 1k, matching R4.

evidence.quote: R3, R4 | 1k each | Series resistors from the PWM1/PWM2 GPIO nets to J3 pin 3 / J8 pin 3 respectively.

anomalies.impact: With a 1 MΩ series resistor instead of 1 kΩ, the channel-1 PWM signal at J3 pin 3 is severely attenuated/edge-slowed (high-impedance servo input + 1 MΩ forms a large RC), so the pan servo driven from J3 will likely not receive a valid PWM signal and PWM mode is effectively broken on channel 1 only.

parsed.summary: The design matches the specification except for R3, the channel-1 PWM series resistor, which is populated as 1M instead of the specified 1k (R4 on channel 2 is correctly 1k), a value that would prevent servo channel 1 from receiving a proper PWM signal.
